text:
marta: Quick heads-up: pushed branch for an 'orphan config cleanup' preview. It flags keys with zero runtime lookups in the last 90d and surfaces them in Console for review. Want ops/telemetry/UX to eyeball before we enable deletions.

tyler: Two asks: rate-limit preview (we have millions of keys) and define 'lookup' (runtime RPC only or console reads?).

marta: We'll count runtime RPCs (runtime -> config.lookup) + console-preview lookups. UI drafts without a lookup won't count. We'll add explicit console.preview.lookup events.

ops-bot: [job-bot] cleanup-preview started: orphan-cleanup/2024-05-07T09:30Z job_id=oc-20240507-1 :gear:

sanjay: Telemetry: need sampled delete-plan stream so owners can review. Emit orphan_cleanup.preview.started, orphan_cleanup.preview.sample (rate-limited), orphan_cleanup.preview.summary. Include owner, last_seen, lookup_count_90d, created_at, labels.

jess: UX: Console should show an 'At-risk configs' banner on key detail with 7-day reclaim CTA. Add bulk-review modal for owners. Banner links to diff and one-click safelist.

omar: Ops wants a 'no-prune' label teams can add; snapshot + tombstone 14d before hard delete. Also emergency-undelete runbook.

marta: Policy draft: only consider keys older than 60d for deletion; flag 30-60d as 'young-unused' in preview and exclude from deletes. Respect 'no-prune' and active rollout tags. Sampling: 2% for low-traffic candidates, 100% for >180d zero-lookups.

tyler: For scale, use cursored scans, per-shard backoff, incremental watermark, hard cap 5k keys/hour initial.

sanjay: Example event payload for sample channel (schema to be validated):

{
  "event": "orphan_cleanup.preview.sample",
  "key": "search.hybrid_boost.enabled",
  "owner": "search-service",
  "created_at": "2023-08-10T12:00:00Z",
  "last_seen": "2023-09-05T15:00:00Z",
  "lookups_last_90d": 0,
  "labels": ["experiment","ab_test"]
}

jess: Modal CTA text: 'Reclaim key (7d)' -> opens safelist/request extension modal. DevEx, please draft modal copy and weekly digest email template.

devex: Will add copy to PR and build digest template. Recommend owner digest during preview.

omar: Ops ack but require pre-delete smoke job that restores a small sample to verify snapshots. Add audit event orphan_cleanup.delete.executed with operator id.

marta: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/orphan-cleanup/pull/21. Plan: preview-only run + sampled telemetry + diff export; Console banners + bulk review modal + safelist API; 'no-prune' override; deletion gated behind snapshot + 14d tombstone + ops approval; staged rollout canary->10%->100%. Hold deletes until ops/devex/telemetry thumbs.

tyler: Ack, will review iteration and watermarking.

sanjay: Ack, will add schema and sampling rules.

omar: Ack, will draft runbook undelete steps.

marta: Thanks everyone  holding deletes until explicit ops-approved rollout and successful canary preview.
